description: The temporal half of the negation signal: the user removed an item on one run and put it back on the next. Only the latest decision counts, so the card must carry no standing rejection. A card that appended rejections instead of resolving them would suppress an item the user deliberately restored — the same stale-memory failure the #21 Knowledge-Updates eval guards against on the KG side.
